assumptions.choice: Main session defined as 09:30 to 16:00 ET; skipping the first 3 minutes restricts entry times to 09:33 through 16:00 ET.
assumptions.reason: Standard US equity market hours are 09:30 to 16:00 ET; skipping 3 minutes means trades start at 09:33.

assumptions.choice: Take-profit (+0.01) and Stop-loss (-0.02) orders are submitted as Limit and Stop orders upon entry order completion, while signal reversal and 3-bar timeout are checked dynamically in next().
assumptions.reason: Limit and Stop orders allow exact intra-bar execution matching price limits, while dynamic conditions cancel active bracket exit orders and close market on signal reversal or timeout.

assumptions.choice: Position size is specified by parameter 'stake' with default 100, clamped between 100 and 500 shares.
assumptions.reason: Matches the specification requiring position size from 100 to 500 shares.
